title: ARIA Awards Set Date, Venue and Partners For 40th Anniversary Ceremony
summary: SYDNEY, Australia — The 40th ARIA Awards will be presented Wednesday, Nov. 18 at Sydney’s Hordern Pavilion, on Gadigal land — the sixth consecutive year at the iconic venue. Spotify returns as headline sponsor for the ARIAs, the Australian recording industry’s flagship awards ceremony, while free-t…
body: SYDNEY, Australia — The 40th ARIA Awards will be presented Wednesday, Nov. 18 at Sydney’s Hordern Pavilion, on Gadigal land — the sixth consecutive year at the iconic venue. Spotify returns as headline sponsor for the ARIAs, the Australian recording industry’s flagship awards ceremony, while free-to-air network 10 will broadcast the ceremony, and Paramount+ will stream it live. Also announced today (Aug. 19) by labels body ARIA, the date for the 2026 ARIA Awards nominations. The full shortlist will be unveiled on Thursday, Sept. 24. “Australian music is electric, ever-evolving and has never failed to set the cultural conversation ablaze right around the world,” comments ARIA CEO Annabelle Herd . “The ARIA Awards have had the best seat in the house for four decades of one incredible show. Whatever gets thrown at Aussie music, our artists find a way to cut through. Now is no exception.” The likes of multiple ARIA Award winners Amyl and The Sniffers , The Kid LAROI, Ninajirachi , Dom Dolla and Troye Sivan “are all proof of that,” Herd continues, “and there is a generation behind them who will take Australian music somewhere none of us can picture yet. “That’s exactl…

title: Play Jay Worthy’s 16-Bit Video Game ‘P of the Week’: ‘It Feels Like a Mix of My Two Favorite Games’
summary: The retro video game comes a couple of weeks before his collab album with George Clinton drops.
body: Jay Worthy isn’t letting up. The West Coast MC (by way of Vancouver) continues the follow-up to his stellar Once Upon a Time series with Generation P , a collab album with none other than the legendary George Clinton , as he and his partner-in-crime producer Sean House form like Voltron as the duo LNDN DRGS. They already dropped a couple of singles in “Knee Deep,” featuring Snoop Dogg, and “Atomic P,” and now they released a cool little 16-bit video game called P of the Week with the help of designer Kyle Zimmer where fans can play as Jay Worthy in a sort of Super Mario/Streets of Rage mash-up. “I’m an old video game collector and am just happy that I have my own game with my homies as characters,” Worthy told Complex . “It feels like a mix of my two favorite games,  Super Mario  and  Streets of Rage —Mario being Nintendo,  Streets of Rage  being Sega. They both had that feel to me growing up.” Zimmer made sure the game had a retro feel to it and wanted gamers to experience how it felt playing video games on old school monitors. “I wanted the game to feel like something you grew up playing o…
